scope: Validation-only saved moment-prefix normalization and finite-eta partial sums; no coefficient or equation inference from references

normalization.master_owner: symbolica_amflow::vacuum::tadpole for explicitly identified one-factor Gaussian channels only
normalization.compact_owner: producer-declared product mu^(D-2)/(sqrt(pi)*Gamma((D-1)/2)), evaluated with native Precision
normalization.target_signs: preserved verbatim from producer; no extra Wick or per-cut phase

strictness.coefficients: saved exact rational strings only, complete indices 0..N-1 for every declared target, missing tail never filled
strictness.master_channels: exact family/index identity, positive scale/mass, unsupported channel fails
strictness.input: exact saved identity and actual prepared family
strictness.prediction_before_reference: normalize and partial-sum processes do not open any numerical reference; comparison reads both only after predictions are written and hashed

numerical_checks.eta8: Report each term-count error, precision and truncation refinements; numerical consistency is empirical unless separate source-based convergent-germ coverage is supplied
numerical_checks.eta2: Raw-series values are outside the intended initial disk and diagnostic only; never accept endpoint or continuation from divergent sums
numerical_checks.reference: only frozen empirical-refinement-passing eta8 and eta2 node32/digits80 references
